register.title: Register as a DRep
register.caption:
Registering as a Delegated Representative (DRep) on Cardano lets you vote on governance proposals, shaping the blockchain's future. To register, you'll need a refundable 500 {{currency}} deposit, which you get back when you deregister.

Adding a metadata file when you register allows you to share your goals and get delegation from other {{currency}} holders, boosting your voting power.
register.notallowed: This wallet type doesn't support registering as a DRep, bummer :(

common.caption: To withdraw staking rewards, this account needs to be delegated to a Delegated Representative (DRep) option: you can delegate to a DRep, choose to abstain, or select 'no confidence.' Don't worry, rewards will still pile up even without a DRep delegation.
